_: The rights matrix. Written by scripts/route-rights-matrix.test.mjs (UPDATE_RIGHTS_MATRIX=1); read the header of that file. cells = one letter per person in "roles" order: D denied, A allowed (got past the gate), N nothing there for this method, S not sent. "intended" appears only where today answer is NOT the policy (SUSPICIOUS in "note"); the test is green on today answer and counts these as known problems to fix deliberately, then re-run with UPDATE_RIGHTS_MATRIX=1. "note" with REVIEW = looked at, low risk. Caveat: an A on a per-agent cell can be a 400/404 the handler gives before it reaches its gate (the probe has no real ask, token or chat id), so A means "not stopped by the gate", not "got data".

legend.A: allowed (past the gate: 2xx, or a 4xx/5xx from the handler itself)
legend.N: no route for this method (404 Not found, or the app shell)
legend.S: not sent (would sign the person out)

POST /hapi/audio/transcribe.note: REVIEW: open to every signed-in person on purpose, but the gate answers before looking at the agent, so a member naming agent B reaches the engine with profile=agent-b (users.mjs:187; the proxy test lists it in OPEN_BY_DESIGN).

GET /issue/i00000000/aaaaaaaaaa.note: SUSPICIOUS: the token is never checked, anyone with a made-up token gets a page that names the agent and the issue (server.mjs:2851, audit B-L3). Policy: a wrong token is refused.

POST /ui/agent-safe.note: PROBE ARTIFACT: member@main is A only because "Unknown agent" (agent=default) is answered before the gate (server.mjs:3300); not a hole.

POST /ui/apps/check.note: REVIEW (low): any member can ask for the status of any Live app by id, no owner or admin check (server.mjs:3518, live.check(id)).

GET /ui/box.note: SUSPICIOUS: no role check; any signed-in member gets the box memory, process groups and each agent's memory (server.mjs:3185). Policy: admins only.

POST /ui/explain.note: REVIEW (low): any member can start a model-backed explanation (cost) (server.mjs:4005).

POST /ui/google/finish.note: REVIEW (low): finishing a pending Google sign-in checks no owner of the agent, only the one-time state (server.mjs:3496, audit N-5).

GET /ui/labels.note: REVIEW (low): every member gets every label (server.mjs:4002), not only those of agents they may use.

GET /ui/skills-policy/who.note: REVIEW (low): any member can ask which agents a skill would reach (server.mjs:3325).
